description: Calculate risers, riser height, tread run, stringer length, slope angle and stringer count from the total rise, with a to-scale side profile. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/stair-calc

mount.description: Top of stair — Flush has one fewer tread than risers.

rise.description: Total rise (floor to floor or to deck) — Vertical distance from the lower surface to the top surface.

riserOverride.description: Riser count override (optional) — Whole number 1 to 40. Leave blank to calculate.

spacing.description: Stringer spacing (in) — Maximum on-center distance between stringers.

targetRiser.description: Target riser height (in) — From 4 to 9 in. The riser count is rise ÷ target, rounded.

tread.description: Tread run (in) — Horizontal depth of each tread.

name: calculate_stair_stringer
title: Stair Stringer / Rise & Run Calculator
